# Fail-closed production contract for Google Drive wallet backup.
#
# SHA-256 of the exact `WEB_CLIENT_ID_RELEASE` Google OAuth web client id
# (project 621183184145) compiled into every official release from 2.4.1
# through 4.2.0. Drive keeps wallet backups per Google Cloud project, so the
# Play release must keep this client or upgrading users lose sight of their
# backups. The id itself stays in the GitHub secret and local.properties; it is
# not the `client_type: 3` entry of 4.2.0's google-services.json.
# Change this line only in a reviewed pull request that moves Drive backup to a
# new client in the same Cloud project.
